offerings.name: Google Search API (SERP API)
offerings.pricing: Top-up model, no monthly subscription. Starter $50 (50k credits, $1.00/1k); Standard $375 (500k credits, $0.75/1k); Scale $1250 (2.5M credits, $0.50/1k); Ultimate $3750 (12.5M credits, $0.30/1k); excluding sales tax/VAT/GST
offerings.price_basis: Starter 档 (最低公开档, $1.00/1k credits, 每次查询消耗 1 credit)
offerings.free_quota: 2,500 free queries, no credit card required
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果 (JSON: organic/knowledgeGraph/peopleAlsoAsk/relatedSearches 等)
offerings.note: 结果 1-2 秒返回，实时查询不缓存；可自定义国家与语言；credits 6 个月内有效；Starter 50 QPS，Ultimate 300 QPS，可协商更高并发；支持 Images/News/Maps/Places/Videos/Shopping/Scholar/Patents/Autocomplete 等垂直搜索
